entries.task_id: the buddha|was|staying near sāvatthī in jeta’s grove
entries.description: the Buddha was staying near Sāvatthī in Jeta’s Grove
entries.subject: the Buddha
entries.object: staying near Sāvatthī in Jeta’s Grove

spans.text: At one time the Buddha was staying near Sāvatthī in Jeta’s Grove, Anāthapiṇḍika’s monastery.
Tatra kho bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi: There the Buddha addressed the mendicants, “bhikkhavo”ti.
Tassa amanasikaraṇīyānaṁ dhammānaṁ amanasikārā manasikaraṇīyānaṁ dhammānaṁ manasikārā anuppannā ceva āsavā na uppajjanti, uppannā ca āsavā pahīyanti.

entries.task_id: yātrā|ca|me bhavissati anavajjatā ca phāsuvihāro ca’
entries.description: yātrā ca me bhavissati anavajjatā ca phāsuvihāro ca’
entries.subject: yātrā
entries.object: me bhavissati anavajjatā ca phāsuvihāro ca’

spans.text: Paṭisaṅkhā yoniso piṇḍapātaṁ paṭisevati: Reflecting rationally, they make use of almsfood: ‘neva davāya, na madāya, na maṇḍanāya, na vibhūsanāya, yāvadeva imassa kāyassa ṭhitiyā yāpanāya, vihiṁsūparatiyā, brahmacariyānuggahāya, iti purāṇañca vedanaṁ paṭihaṅkhāmi navañca vedanaṁ na uppādessāmi, yātrā ca me bhavissati anavajjatā ca phāsuvihāro ca’.
Tatra kho bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi: There the Buddha addressed the mendicants, “bhikkhavo”ti.
